## August 28 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 267)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 28** across American network radio, the BBC Radio 4, and Kroger syndication, two episodes of Penny Ward in *Hearts in Harmony*, two generational eras of BBC's legendary parlor game *Just a Minute* (1982 Kenneth Williams & Clement Freud and 2000 Paul Merton & Ross Noble), Frank and Anne Hummert's *Young Widder Brown* for Bayer Aspirin, and Don Douglas tracking stolen microfilm in *John Steele, Adventurer* (1946–2000):
